Message:
drm/i915: Only set CURSOR_PIPE_CSC_ENABLE when cursor is enabled

It seems cleaner if we keep CURCNTR at 0 when the cursor is disabled,
so don't set the CURSOR_PIPE_CSC_ENABLE bit unless the cursor is
enabled.
